author: crow
title: Weekly story scene illustration commissions
content: Hello! My name is Crow, and I’m a writer over on AO3! Welcome to something I’m calling “One Artist a Week!” The idea is pretty simple: every week, I want to commission an artist for around $30–$40 to draw a scene they genuinely enjoyed from one of my stories. If you’ve read any of my work, liked it, and there’s a scene you’d love to draw, I’d be more than happy to commission you! My DMs are open. Budget around $30–$40 a week. No AI art. Artwork will be added to the story with credit.
